issues.summary: The shared parser silently overwrote repeated options (--out a --out b -> last wins), so a malformed invocation still degraded to a wrong-but-successful run instead of an honest usage error.
issues.resolution: OptionParser.Parse now rejects a repeated --key (value or flag, case-insensitive) with ArgumentException -> exit-1 usage path. No subcommand documents a repeatable option (list-valued options take a single comma-separated value). Pinned by 3 new OptionParserTests cases. Pre-existing in all seven prior ParseOptions copies; O-1-4 consolidation made it closeable in one place.
